name: F-16C with 4 × AIM-120 (AIM-120C-DCS), airframe fitted to DCS, radar as a skilled human runs DCS's (APG-68-DCS-HUMAN)
description: F-16C-DCSFIT with the APG-68-DCS-HUMAN radar (SIM_REV 22): DCS's player radar run by a skilled human, 55 km and 4 s to a track. The opponent to train against for fights with a human pilot.

sources.WPN_COUNT: standard BVR loadout in this project
sources.RCS_M2: commonly cited open-source frontal estimate (≈ 1.2 m²)
sources.SPEED_CMDS: the action set existing checkpoints were trained with; 460 m/s added in SIM_REV 14 (Mach 1.5 at 9 km, the DCS AI's dash in combat)
sources.CLIMB_FPA_LO: holds speed on a 3 km climb (measured)
sources.LAUNCH_DELAY_MIN: split of the 7-14 s measured 14 October (fire_delay_20261014_141533.json, every trial with the bug dropped first, release estimated 2.5 s): the release (master arm, the weapon release held 1.5 s, the launch seen), 2.5-4 s, the delay with the track already bugged; the stick pilot's radar job bugs a held track ahead of a shot. Replace with: python dcs/stick/fire_delay.py set F-16C-DCSFIT <that file>
sources.LAUNCH_DELAY_MAX: split of the 7-14 s measured 14 October (fire_delay_20261014_141533.json, every trial with the bug dropped first, release estimated 2.5 s): the release (master arm, the weapon release held 1.5 s, the launch seen), 2.5-4 s, the delay with the track already bugged; the stick pilot's radar job bugs a held track ahead of a shot. Replace with: python dcs/stick/fire_delay.py set F-16C-DCSFIT <that file>
sources.LAUNCH_BUG_MIN: split of the 7-14 s measured 14 October (fire_delay_20261014_141533.json, every trial with the bug dropped first, release estimated 2.5 s): the bug, 7-14 s less the release, added for a track held less than LAUNCH_BUG_READY_S
sources.LAUNCH_BUG_MAX: split of the 7-14 s measured 14 October (fire_delay_20261014_141533.json, every trial with the bug dropped first, release estimated 2.5 s): the bug, 7-14 s less the release, added for a track held less than LAUNCH_BUG_READY_S
sources.LAUNCH_BUG_READY_S: the stick pilot's radar job (every 15 s while idle) bugs a held track with up to 6 s of presses: by 25 s a held track is bugged
